pictures.author: Yerevantsi
pictures.observed: Actually viewed south-side exterior:large pointed turquoise dome with broad pale/dark chevron and yellow bands,low brick drum,raised central brick hall with three pointed windows and red shallow roof,two lower weathered brick cupolas/red wing roofs,and one cylindrical brick minaret with a broad open balcony and small tiled cap at the eastern end. Reference camera about44.50536/40.17753 supports minaretpositiveX/east. Trees obscure lower thresholds. Dimensions and unseen north side remain estimates.

pictures.observed: Actually viewed close exterior:pointed broad turquoise dome,zigzag lower band,yellow middle band,selected yellow medallions and dark/pale upper diamonds;short brick drum and small finial. Model uses original sparse geometric accents and shared mosaic tile,not copied pixels,calligraphy or exact tile art. Older picture does not establish current conservation finish.
